pages.text: The roots remain. Their orders do not.
pages.title: After silence
A quieter country
pages.text: Routine expeditions establish a foothold after two completions. The terminal then offers that dimension’s Sever the Bloom mission, or its authored confrontation. Defeat the mission’s bound guardian and extract to liberate the

pages.title: A quieter country
pages.text: dimension for everyone. Routine completions alone cannot replace that proof.

pages.title: A quieter country
pages.text: Liberation silences ambient heart seeding, growth and infection there; the attention bar and pursuit hunts end. Dormant growth remains as a scar. Ordinary native monsters and vanilla hazards still exist.

pages.title: A quieter country
pages.text: Completing the first Field Survey opens remote terminal deployments. The Stillness already shelters home; its optional confrontations do not gate the frontier. Native portals remain usable earlier, if you accept the danger. A

pages.title: A quieter country
pages.text: guardian sent by the hunt is only an echo: killing it does not sever the dimension.

pages.title: Power after silence
pages.text: Guardian victory and successful extraction leave more than quiet ground. Craft an Unattuned Severance Core and attune it at a terminal here. A Severance Cradle can then draw stable power from the remnant anywhere.

pages.title: Power after silence
pages.text: This proof is shared with the world and persists with the campaign. A count-only cleared mark is not an accepted guardian victory. Existing genuine boss trophies can recover old proof. Resetting a source dimension pauses its cores
